I replied to Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message and pointed out a problem with the date. Today is 14 Oct 2026, so a 6 June 2026 deadline has already passed. I asked whether he meant 6 June 2027, or whether the Halyard rollout is already finished.

I also told him I couldn't find anything about Halyard or a 6 June deadline in #central-team or in the shared files he can see. The last Marrow Agrisupply update in the channel is from 9 June 2026, when the account had escalated over the slow store rollout. Two open items were raised then: ticket PD-4821, where the Eastbank door labels don't match, and the morning shift missing at Pine Crossing. Nothing posted since says either was fixed.

I didn't change anything else.
